notes.title: I FINALLY CAVED OKAY FINE!!!!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey my wonderful very very very niche fanbase!![/h1]

[h2]I finally gave in and did it..... after all of the complaints.[/h2]

I finally Nerfed Level 2. Mainly talking about the boss, Mr. Tree.

Changes:
Mr. Tree Health:
100 -> 65

I hope people can now enjoy the game and keep playing!

notes.title: About Level 2....
notes.content: [h1]~~~~ ABOUT LEVEL 2.... THE FOREST LEVEL. ~~~~ːsteamfacepalmː[/h1][p][/p][h2]I've recently gotten some feedback regarding level 2. I've heard that people can't even beat it on fragile mode, and it makes the game unplayable. [/h2][p][/p][p]Well.... [/p][p][/p][p]I'm thinking of nerfing level 2. I know I know, I'm not supposed to care, but heh... I'm only human after all..... [/p][p][/p][p]Comment on this if you CAN NOT beat level 2. ːsteamhappyː[/p]

notes.title: HEY GUYS!!!!
notes.content:
[h1]WHATS UP MY WONDERFUL FANBASE!!!![/h1]

[h2]~~~We added a fragile mode to the game for Lilja and Baylie because its too hard for them.~~~[/h2]

This new mode may be a little finicky but you should be able to play with it. You will not earn certain achievements if you beat the game on Fragile Mode.

[h3]HAVE FUN!!! [/h3]
